lines: The originally cold and refreshing tunnel was now filled with the smell of blood and sweat.
The soldiers were lying on the floor in heaps, their stomachs torn wide open.
The last standing soldier was frantically trying to aim his gun, his feet slipping on the blood-soaked floor.
Ahaha! Too bad♪ Saya won't get caught by you!
One tentacle rose up into the air, aiming for the soldier's head.
At that moment, the sound of countless footsteps echoed noisily through the tunnel, signaling the arrival of another squad.
Saya's expression changed when she saw the new troops.
Hmph. You're such a troublesome brat, making all this work for us.
Saya turned around and tried to flee in the opposite direction. But she was surrounded by soldiers from that side as well.
As the soldier who appeared to be the leader raised his hand, the soldiers pulled out not guns, but something looking like a machine, and pressed a button.
And as they did so, Saya suddenly began to groan in pain.
Hahaha, seems to be working huh. This device is emitting "that sound" that you hate oh so much. Not that we can hear it though.
It hurts! It hurrrts!!! Make it stooop!
Apparently this sound makes the device in your body send out waves of pain? Hmm? That does sound pretty painful.
The tentacles of the struggling Saya pierced through several soldiers.
Tsk! Stubborn little brat! Catch her, quick!
The soldiers jumped at Saya in an attempt to restrain her. ーAnd at that moment.
A soldier was suddenly struck in the face and collapsed to the floor. This hadn't been Saya's doing.
What!? Uwah, there's a flying fist!?ーUmph!!
The soldiers were struck and collapsed to the floor one after the other by a fist that had suddenly appeared in the air.
E-Everyone, stay calm!! I've seen this before, I think that's the Demon Fist Taimanーuargh.
Phew, I think that should be it. I've cleared the small fries away, Fuma.
After the last soldier had been knocked out, a beautiful woman with gently flowing silver hair appeared.
Amaziiing! Against armored soldiers with your bare hands... you're incredible, Rinka-senpai!
There wasn't even time for Heberybody else to help. That must be why they call you the "Demon Fist Taimanin," Rinka-senpai!
Shikanosuke, Hebiko, and I had been watching from the shadows and were awed by her strength.
(The Smoke Jutsu normally isn't meant for combat, but when combined with martial arts it becomes this strong huh...)
The Smoke Jutsu was a Ninja Art with which the user could turn parts of their body into smoke.
To combine this Ninja Art with martial arts to turn her arms to smoke and send her fists flying was the fighting style of the "Demon Fist Taimanin," Shido Rinka.
The "Two Taimanin 'Rins'" together with Akiyama Rinko... Hebiko also wants to be famous like that someday.
Oh, but you two are already famous. "Hebiko and Shikanosuke from the Independent Commando Unit."
That's just our normal names though!
Hey, stop playing around. Looks like that's our target.
I looked at the girl standing there completely dumbfounded.
She's different from what Hebiko imagined, she looks like a sweet little girl.
B-But um, those are some dangerous-looking tentacles coming from her back!?
As I slowly stepped closer, Saya Neo stared at me in confusion.
(So we have to eliminate this girl... No, this is our mission. I have to do it...)
Oh, if it ain't you guys again!
Don't tell me y'all are after Saya NEO too?
U-Uwah!? The cyborg we met in Yomihara!?
That's "Hestia-sama." Remember it well, ya brat.
This time the cyborg woman Hestia had appeared with reinforcements.
You're the pursuer, of all people...
Oh, well... I was gettin' bored of this lame mission, capturin' a runaway test subject.
And I never expected y'all to show up. Thing's're gettin' interestin' now!
Out of the frying pan, and into the fire. The atmosphere between Hestia and us was starting to heat up.
